name: DeepGlobe: Satellite Image Understanding Challenge
description: A benchmark dataset designed to advance deep learning for high-resolution satellite image analysis, organized for the EarthVision workshop at CVPR 2018 in collaboration with DigitalGlobe. Encompasses three challenging geographic tasks: Road Extraction (sub-pixel road network segmentation across 6,226 tiles), Building Detection (polygon footprint localization across 24,586 tiles), and Land Cover Classification (pixel-wise multi-class segmentation of 7 surface categories across 1,146 tiles).
